keyed.HH.Setting.wellness.priceHotTub.Desc: What a guest pays for one soak in a hot tub. Multiplied by the venue's price factor.
keyed.HH.Setting.wellness.priceSauna.Desc: What a guest pays for one sauna session.
keyed.HH.Setting.wellness.priceMassage.Desc: What a guest pays for one massage. Only given when a colonist with the Serving work type is free to give it.
keyed.HH.Setting.wellness.dayPass.Desc: Wealthier guests buy a day pass instead of paying per session. It covers hot tub and sauna, not massage.
keyed.HH.Setting.wellness.priceDayPass.Desc: Price of the spa day pass (hot tub and sauna for the pass duration).
keyed.HH.Setting.wellness.dayPassHours.Desc: How long a day pass stays valid.
Price reduction when nobody on staff is in the room. A colonist with the Serving work type standing in the room counts as staff.
keyed.HH.Setting.wellness.hoursSauna.Desc: How long one sauna session lasts.
keyed.HH.Setting.wellness.hoursMassage.Desc: How long one massage lasts. Both masseur and client are busy that long.
keyed.HH.Setting.wellness.massageWaitHours.Des: How long someone lies on the table waiting for a masseur before giving up.
keyed.HH.Setting.wellness.saunaMinTemp.Desc: A sauna stove only counts as a working sauna when its room is at least this warm.
keyed.HH.Setting.wellness.joyFactor.Desc: Multiplier on the recreation colonists get from hot tub, sauna and massage.
keyed.HH.Setting.wellness.restBonus.Desc: Share of the rest bar restored by a session (a little more for a massage). Set 0 for none.
keyed.HH.Setting.wellness.soothe.Desc: A session leaves the pawn soothed for about a day: pain is felt 15 % less.
keyed.HH.Setting.wellness.massageXp.Desc: Social and Medicine experience the masseur earns for a full massage.
keyed.HH.Setting.wellness.satisfaction.Desc: How much a finished session raises a guest's satisfaction (scale -1 to +1).
keyed.HH.Setting.wellness.guestWeight.Desc: How strongly guests want the spa compared to other activities. 0 = they never go.
keyed.HH.Setting.wellness.guestCooldownHours.D: A guest does not start another spa session sooner than this.
keyed.HH.Setting.wellness.rehabJoy.Desc: With RimWard active, walking patients in a colony medical bed may visit hot tub, sauna and massage table for recreation (never the sauna after surgery or with open wounds).
keyed.HH.Wellness.Inspect.SaunaNotReady: Not a working sauna yet: {0} °C of {1} °C needed ({2}).
keyed.HH.Wellness.Inspect.MassageWaiting: Someone is waiting for a masseur.
keyed.HH.Wellness.Inspect.Users: Colonists may use: {0}. Guests may use: {1}.
keyed.HH.Wellness.Gizmo.ColonistsDesc: Allow colonists to use this for recreation. Turn off while the spa is open for business.
keyed.HH.Wellness.Gizmo.GuestsDesc: Allow guests to use this (they pay when it stands in a spa venue).

defs.JoyKindDef/HH_Relaxation.label: spa relaxation
defs.ThingDef/HH_HotTub.label: hot tub
defs.ThingDef/HH_HotTub.description: A wooden tub with a heating coil and a pump that mostly works. Two people can soak at once. Colonists get recreation and a calm mood; guests in a spa venue pay for the privilege.
defs.ThingDef/HH_Sauna.label: sauna stove
defs.ThingDef/HH_Sauna.description: A stone-lined wood stove that turns a small closed room into a sauna. The room counts as a sauna once it stays at or above the minimum temperature set in the mod settings (45 °C by default). Keep it fed with wood and keep the room small and walled in.
defs.ThingDef/HH_MassageTable.label: massage table
defs.ThingDef/HH_MassageTable.description: A padded table with a face hole and a shelf of oils. Needs a colonist with the Serving work type to do the kneading; they gain Social and Medicine experience, the client pays (guests) or relaxes (colonists).
defs.ThingDef/HH_TestOnly_VenueSign.label: test venue sign (test only)
defs.ThingDef/HH_TestOnly_VenueSign.descripti: Only for automated tests. Cannot be built.
defs.WorkGiverDef/HH_GiveMassage.label: give massage
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_Bathhouse.label: bathhouse
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_Bathhouse.descript: Wood-fired saunas and massage tables. Hot rooms, warm company, and a reason for guests to stay another afternoon.
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_Wellness.label: wellness
defs.ResearchProjectDef/HH_Wellness.descripti: Heated tubs with pumps and a proper spa. Needs electricity, charges accordingly.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_Relaxed.stages.0.label: soaked
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_Relaxed.stages.0.descripti: Warm water, no hurry. The world can wait.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_Relaxed.stages.1.label: sweated it out
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_Relaxed.stages.1.descripti: Sat in the heat until the worries ran off. Lighter now.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_Relaxed.stages.2.label: freshly kneaded
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_Relaxed.stages.2.descripti: Somebody finally found that knot. I could sleep for a week.
defs.HediffDef/HH_Soothed.label: soothed
defs.HediffDef/HH_Soothed.description: Warm, loose and a little drowsy after a spa session. Pain is felt less for about a day.
